activity_summary: After the comedy you stayed in the tiring-house. The yard had been the biggest since Easter Monday, more apprentices than sweethearts, loud before the play and in it. Kemp had fed it. Garnish stopped counting at fifteen, and the hush at the messenger had come late and broken early. Margery emptied her box without her usual line. She said the apprentices were thick as flies, and that they laughed like men who mean to laugh at something else after. Burbage shrugged it off. You did not. Kemp had danced the jig of the slippers, and the yard would not let him go. You did not mend the hush.

entities.name: William Shakespeare
entities.context: Refused the shrug, and left the hush as it stood.

entities.name: Goodwife Margery Pell
entities.context: Emptied the box without her usual line, and said what the yard had been.

entities.name: Will Kemp
entities.context: Claimed the slippers and the yard that would not let him go.

entities.name: Richard Burbage
entities.context: Shrugged it off, and called the afternoon a holiday yard.

entities.name: Abel Garnish
entities.context: Stopped his count at fifteen, and asked that the hush not be mended by a jig.

quotes.speaker: margery_pell
quotes.text: 'Prentices thick as flies, and no good humour in them. They laughed like men who mean to laugh at something else after.
